name: Virtual Analog Crossfade
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Emilie Gillet's original virtual-analog variant 1: a detuned pair crossfading through dry tone into hard sync.

controls.label: Detune
controls.description: Detunes the secondary oscillator through musical intervals.

controls.label: Detune to sync
controls.description: Moves from the detuned pair through the dry primary to hard synchronization.

controls.label: Common waveform
controls.description: Changes all oscillator paths through the same variable waveform range.

controls.label: Detune range
controls.description: Scales interval detuning around the original range at its midpoint.

outputs.main: Crossfade from the detuned pair through the dry primary to its synchronized form.

upstream: Mutable Instruments eurorack Plaits source, original VA_VARIANT 1 with Plaits Palette macro and stereo integration
